scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducer are self-contained; finite checker is corroboration. Source comparison qualified by older possibly inaccessible literature.
scientific_limitations: Only real bi-infinite alternating positive knot lengths, data-independent convex-adjacent-secant Hermite slopes, unweighted finite discrete variation; does not apply to general nonuniform Catmull-Rom interpolation, data-dependent limiters or other norms. Archival source day identifies the 2005 public text, not the historical invention of cubic Hermite interpolation. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp variation-optimal affine-reproducing cubic Hermite slopes on alternating meshes
